content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I forgot my password and need to reset it.
No problem! Please go to the login page and click the 'Forgot Password?' link below the sign-in fields.
I clicked it. Now it's asking for my username or email.
Great. Please enter the email address you use for your account, then hit 'Submit.'
Okay, I entered my email and submitted. It says they'll send me a reset link.
Perfect! Check your inbox for an email from us. There should be a link to reset your password.
I got the email. Should I just click the link?
Yes, click the link and you'll be taken to a page where you can choose a new password. Make sure it’s something secure and unique.
All done. Thanks for your help!
